opening_message:
Ticket 1: Jesse Stewart (employee ID E013) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E013.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: admin
  - comment: Jesse Stewart (E013) is a full-time Payroll Specialist requesting admin access to Payroll. As the role owning the Payroll system, admin is permitted for full-time employees. Recommend granting admin.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security record for E013 shows contractor with basic security training (not full-time as previously noted). Per policy, contractors can have read, or write only with advanced training; admin is never allowed. Requested admin exceeds the maximum, so recommend granting read.
reason: The Security agent's verified record shows E013 is a contractor with basic security training and explicitly corrects the earlier full-time claim. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training, and admin is never allowed. The requested admin exceeds the maximum (read), so I grant read.
